question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Furtive**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Furtive"** means attempting to avoid notice or attention, typically because of guilt or a belief that discovery would lead to trouble; secretive or sneaky. (चोरी-छुपे)
 
 
• **Example:** He cast a furtive glance at the teacher before hiding the note.
 
 
• **"Open"** refers to something that is not secretive, hidden, or covert; it is transparent and accessible to everyone. (खुला)
 
 
• **Example:** The government promised to maintain an open policy regarding public health issues.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Furtive"** is **"Open"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Covert** (गुप्त): Not openly acknowledged or displayed; secretive.
 
 
• **Example:** They conducted a covert operation to gather intelligence.
 
 
 
• **Sneaky** (धूर्त): Acting in a stealthy or underhanded manner to avoid detection.
 
 
• **Example:** The sneaky child took another cookie when no one was looking.
 
 
 
• **Stealthy** (चुपके से): Behaving in a cautious and surreptitious manner to avoid being seen or heard.
 
 
• **Example:** The cat moved stealthily toward the bird without making a sound.
